description: This PHP class 'EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator' implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu items related to employment status within the OrangeHRM system. It primarily overrides the screen to 'employmentStatus' when invoked.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu for Employment Status in the OrangeHRM system by overriding the screen to 'employmentStatus'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'employmentStatus' for the menu configuration.
